items.title: Frontend Framework
items.content: Use React for the frontend application due to its strong ecosystem, component model, and support for i18n and RTL.

items.title: Authentication Method
items.content: Implement JWT (JSON Web Tokens) for authentication, enabling stateless auth and scaling.

items.title: Primary Database
items.content: Choose PostgreSQL as the primary database for its ACID compliance, JSON support, strong indexing, and good tooling.

items.title: RTL Support
items.content: Make RTL support mandatory for all user-facing screens to ensure consistent RTL layout and text flow for Hebrew and other RTL languages.

source.anchor: RTL and Locale: Mandatory RTL for All Screens

items.title: Primary Brand Color
items.content: Set the primary brand color to #3A5FCD for clear and consistent accents, ensuring readability and contrast on light backgrounds.

items.title: Project Documentation
items.content: Keep project documentation in a .cursor_docs folder with spec.md, decisions.md, and tasks.md for easy access and updates.

items.title: API Conventions
items.content: Use REST or GraphQL with JSON responses, Bearer JWT authentication, and consistent error handling.

items.title: Out of Scope Features
items.content: Real-time presence/typing, file attachments, and email/push notifications are out of scope for the current project specification.
